blur_detection.description: The receipt image is clear with well-defined text characters and sharp edges.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as the text is sufficiently sharp for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt shows excellent contrast between dark text and light background throughout the document.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No improvement needed for contrast as the current level is optimal for automated text extraction.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare or reflections detected that would obscure text or important information.
glare_identification.recommendation: Current lighting conditions are appropriate; maintain similar lighting for future document captures.

water_stains.description: No water damage, staining, or discoloration visible on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue to keep receipts protected from liquids and moisture.

tears_or_folds.description: The receipt shows a slight curve or mild fold at the top portion, but it does not significantly impact text readability.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: When capturing receipts, try to ensure they are placed flat to minimize any curvature or folds.

cut_off_detection.description: All edges of the receipt are fully visible with no content appearing to be cut off from the frame.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Continue capturing full receipt images with adequate margins around the document.

missing_sections.description: The receipt appears complete with header information, line items, tax details, and payment information visible.
missing_sections.recommendation: Current capture technique effectively includes all relevant receipt sections.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or objects obstruct the receipt content.
obstructions.recommendation: Continue using current capture method that keeps the document free from obstructions.
